title: Remember that?
hints: The cache has to live *outside* the returned function but *inside* `memoize` — so each memoized function gets its own private cache.
Use a `Map<A, R>`. Check `cache.has(arg)` rather than `cache.get(arg)` — a cached `0`, `""` or `undefined` is still a cache hit.
const cache = new Map<A, R>(); return (arg) => { if (!cache.has(arg)) cache.set(arg, fn(arg)); return cache.get(arg) as R; };
